tall_narrow.centerline: vertical product centerline locked to canvas center
tall_narrow.baseline: base sits on shared family shelf line
tall_narrow.safe_zone: leave consistent top air and side margins; no cap, base, detached cap, or shadow may touch the canvas edge
tall_narrow.detached_components: detached over-caps sit upright to the right on the same baseline with consistent gap and scale
tall_narrow.scale_logic: use consistent visual height envelope for sibling tall SKUs
prompt_lines: Frame as a tall narrow product on a 2080 x 2288 portrait canvas.
Maintain locked centerline, shared baseline, stable top air, and safe margins.

medium_upright.centerline: body centerline locked to canvas center
medium_upright.baseline: body base sits on shared shelf line
medium_upright.safe_zone: balanced top air and side air for medium upright bottles
medium_upright.detached_components: detached components stay close and aligned to the same floor line
medium_upright.scale_logic: consistent medium product magnification across family
prompt_lines: Frame as a medium upright ecommerce product with balanced negative space.
Preserve centerline, baseline, and product scale for family grid consistency.

wide_bottle.centerline: visual mass centered, not necessarily neck-only center
wide_bottle.baseline: widest base sits on shared shelf line
wide_bottle.safe_zone: allow wider side margins without cropping the shoulders
wide_bottle.detached_components: detached components remain inside side safe zone
wide_bottle.scale_logic: scale by width first, then height
prompt_lines: Frame wide bottles by visual mass so the body reads centered and stable.
Do not crop shoulders, wide bases, or detached components.

low_wide_jar.centerline: jar centerline locked to canvas center
low_wide_jar.baseline: jar bottom sits on low shared shelf line
low_wide_jar.safe_zone: generous side room for wide lid and body
low_wide_jar.detached_components: loose lids remain on same floor line if present
low_wide_jar.scale_logic: scale by jar width and keep low height honest
prompt_lines: Frame low wide jars with width-first scale logic and a stable low baseline.
Do not stretch the jar vertically or make it read as a bottle.

grouped_accessory.centerline: group visual center locked to canvas center
grouped_accessory.baseline: all components share one studio floor line unless reference shows stacked layout
grouped_accessory.safe_zone: every component and shadow remains inside safe margins
grouped_accessory.detached_components: preserve count, spacing, order, and relative scale
grouped_accessory.scale_logic: scale by full group bounding box
prompt_lines: Frame grouped accessories as one coherent SKU assembly, not separate products.
Preserve component count, order, spacing, and relative scale.

box_or_bag.centerline: package visual center locked to canvas center
box_or_bag.baseline: bottom edge or fabric contact area sits on shared shelf line
box_or_bag.safe_zone: keep package edges, drawstrings, folds, and shadows inside safe zone
box_or_bag.detached_components: attached strings, handles, or folds remain connected and uncropped
box_or_bag.scale_logic: scale by package silhouette and front-face readability
prompt_lines: Frame boxes and bags as inspectable ecommerce package objects.
Keep front face, folds, handles, drawstrings, and bottom contact readable.

decorative_silhouette.centerline: dominant silhouette centered while preserving asymmetric details
decorative_silhouette.baseline: base and detached decorative components share one floor line
decorative_silhouette.safe_zone: extra room for ornamental edges, tassels, bulbs, or decorative caps
decorative_silhouette.detached_components: ornamental detached components preserve exact reference placement relationship
decorative_silhouette.scale_logic: scale by full ornamental silhouette, not simple body rectangle
prompt_lines: Frame decorative silhouettes by the full ornamental outline, including bulbs, tassels, facets, and decorative caps.
Do not simplify or crop ornamental geometry.
